description: REQ-001 still does not supply the promised closed field-and-type contract for components. The common, DAILY, PHYSICAL, and MENTAL component keys have no value types or nullability rules, and even the FINANCIAL sentence leaves each named key's count-versus-boolean mapping implicit. Incompatible JSON payloads can therefore satisfy the listed key names while breaking endpoint and UI interoperability, so iteration-1 FIND-001 is not materially closed.

evidence.snippet: components: a JSON object with common timezone and excluded_unknown_count, plus exactly: ... DAILY ... PHYSICAL ... MENTAL ... FINANCIAL
